name: Restricted Adjacency Merging
aliases: Block Merging with Common Border Criterion
definition: A merging strategy that allows a block to merge with its brother or a nephew if they share a common boundary, defined by ancestry type checks.
summary: Restricted Adjacency Merging is a parallel load-balancing strategy that merges completed sub-blocks with non-sibling neighbors sharing a geometric boundary, using ancestry-based criteria to enable asynchronous processing.
